name: model_metadata_parse_available_output_tokens
notes: Output-cap error parser (traced copy of src/agent/provider_metadata.c::parse_available_output_tokens_from_error vs LIVE agent/model_metadata.py::parse_available_output_tokens_from_error). Cup hashes the branch ladder + resulting figure. DOCUMENTED NARROWING (inputs excluded): LIVE also classifies DashScope 'Range of max_tokens should be [1, N]', OpenRouter '(A of text input, B of tool input, C in the output)', LM-Studio char-count and vLLM phrasings and computes a derived available figure; the C port implements only the Anthropic-style max_tokens+available_tokens clause with keyword/'='-fallback extraction. Also excluded: (a) 'available_output_tokens' spelling - C extracts from it, LIVE's regex ladder does not know it; (b) two-word 'available tokens:' phrasing - REAL PORT BUG: C's skip-loop halts at the inner space of the marker phrase so extraction fails (returns -1) while LIVE's r'available\s+tokens[:\s]+(\d+)' extracts the figure; both spellings dropped from this walk and worth a follow-up port fix.
